description: This file defines the Product model class for the OpenCart e-commerce system, containing methods for creating, updating, copying, deleting, and retrieving product data from the database, including handling descriptions, codes, categories, filters, attributes, options, and related entities.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Class representing the Product model in OpenCart, providing methods for CRUD operations, copying, and managing product-related data within the database context.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product record in the database with provided data, including descriptions, codes, categories, filters, images, attributes, options, SEO URLs, layouts, and other product properties.

methods.name: editProduct
methods.description: Edits an existing product record by its ID, updating various fields and related data, including descriptions, codes, categories, filters, images, attributes, and SEO URLs.

methods.name: copyProduct
methods.description: Copies an existing product by its ID, creating a new product with similar data but with reset fields like SKU, UPC, rating, and status.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product and its associated data and related records from the database by its ID, including descriptions, codes, categories, filters, images, attributes, SEO URLs, and reviews.

methods.name: addVariant
methods.description: Creates a new product variant based on a master product, overriding certain properties as specified.

methods.name: editVariant
methods.description: Edits a specific product variant, including overridden data based on the master product.

methods.name: editVariants
methods.description: Updates all variants associated with a master product, applying specified data and overrides.

methods.name: editMasterId
methods.description: Updates the master ID of a product, linking it to another product or unsetting the link.

methods.name: editSale
methods.description: Updates the sale count or status of a product.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a product.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Sets the status (enabled/disabled) of a product.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a product by its ID, decoding JSON fields for variant and override data.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products based on various filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the total number of products matching optional filtering criteria.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByManufacturerId
methods.description: Returns the count of products associated with a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByTaxClassId
methods.description: Returns the count of products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByStockStatusId
methods.description: Returns the count of products with a certain stock status.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByWeightClassId
methods.description: Returns the count of products with a specific weight class.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByLengthClassId
methods.description: Returns the count of products with a specific length class.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a product description entry for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all descriptions associated with a given product.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a product, indexed by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific language.

methods.name: addCode
methods.description: Adds a product code record.

methods.name: deleteCodes
methods.description: Removes all codes associated with a product.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Returns all codes for a product, including their associated identifiers.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Associates a product with a category.

methods.name: deleteCategories
methods.description: Removes category associations for a product.

methods.name: deleteCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Removes associations with a specific category from all products.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of category IDs associated with a product.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Associates a product with a filter.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: Removes filter associations from a product.

methods.name: deleteFiltersByFilterId
methods.description: Removes associations with a specific filter from all products.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns filter IDs associated with a product.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Creates an attribute record for a product in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteAttributes
methods.description: Removes attribute records for a product, optionally filtered by attribute ID.

methods.name: deleteAttributesByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all attribute records for a specific language.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attribute data for a product, including descriptions.

methods.name: getAttributesByLanguageId
methods.description: Gets all product attributes for a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalAttributesByAttributeId
methods.description: Counts how many products have a specific attribute.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Creates a product option record.
